observations.observation: All approved Chinese propositions are present: left donor-doped n side with more numerous free electrons; right acceptor-doped p side with more numerous holes; holes as electron vacancies capable of carrying current; junction as the boundary of conduction types, not whole-sample charge signs; concentration-driven diffusion; electrons filling holes and fixed charged impurity ions; built-in field and energy-barrier explanation; equilibrium diffusion/field-motion balance with no sustained net current. The English paragraph splits do not omit or reverse any causal link.

Forward polarity is faithfully p on the positive terminal and n on the negative terminal, with p at higher potential. Barrier reduction and narrowing of the low-free-carrier region are retained. Majority-carrier diffusion remains electrons n to p and holes p to n, with battery charge replenishment sustaining the process. Electron motion is opposite conventional current and hole motion is in the same direction. Readily conducting and relatively small resistance preserve the approved qualitative comparison, not a fixed resistance or zero barrier.

Forward bias and forward current correctly render the preceding connection and current. The current-voltage characteristic remains an explained relationship between current and applied voltage, with Figure 226a identifying the first panel and no linearity or quantitative-scale claim.

The explicit below-breakdown restriction precedes polarity reversal and the equal-voltage-magnitude comparison. The excluded possibility of large reverse current is explained and named. Increased barrier, wider low-carrier region and impeded majority carriers are retained. Minority electrons cross p to n and minority holes n to p; the minority identities and warning against estimating this current from majority-carrier numbers are complete. Small reverse current remains nonzero, with large reverse resistance limited to the stated range. Figure 226b is reverse and 226c combines the two characteristics. All three panels remain qualitative trends, not readable current/voltage data or measurements of comparable current magnitudes.

The two emphasized conclusions, much smaller forward than reverse resistance and rectification application are complete. Alternating current is defined by changing direction; rectification permits mainly one direction by greatly reducing, not abolishing, reverse current. The final warning explicitly preserves time variation and distinguishes mostly consistent direction from constant magnitude. No smoothing, regulated output or fixed current value is introduced.

All three empty figure placeholders, figure IDs, source references and object positions are preserved. Visible captions are the faithful bare English identifiers Figure 224, Figure 225 and Figure 226, with no invented explanation. Draft figure-placeholder labels are English; the user-specified later restoration of source machine labels is a metadata step, not a reason to translate the visible captions back to Chinese.

The exact long TOC title, Current across the junction between p-type and n-type semiconductors, is retained, including p-before-n order; printed title retains 111. Source chapter and section remain null rather than inferred from the card ID or TOC ancestry. Both approved Chinese and English embedded source snapshots equal the current faithful source. All 11 object kinds, IDs, source_refs, source_text and source ordering are preserved. Every source body math token is retained in the same per-block order: 22 tokens total, distributed 3/7/0/9/3 across narrative blocks 0/5/6/7/10. The requested literal TOC heading uses plain p-type/n-type; the faithful title's original math remains untouched in the source snapshot. No formula, number, exercise, answer, choice or erratum is invented.

All 23 indexed narrative paragraphs match the draft text and block correspondence exactly. The three supplied boundary pairs match draft anchors and resolved breaks [6, 11, 20], preserving transitions from equilibrium to forward bias, forward to reverse bias, and reverse characteristics to rectification. Splitting the Chinese into more English paragraphs changes layout, not proposition order or lesson scope.
